result:
I removed the manual collation from every query that forced it, and deleted the `Collation` module (`lib/collation.rb`), which nothing uses any more. I haven't run the specs or tried the queries against the production database, so I haven't confirmed that unaccented/case-insensitive matching still works without the forced collation.

The queries are the autocomplete searches in `city.rb`, `country.rb`, `institution.rb`, `major.rb`, `state.rb` and `admissions/form_field.rb`. The same cleanup applies to the CPF and email lookups in `admissions/admission_application.rb`. They now match on the column's own collation instead.

The issue's open question is whether the production database's default collation makes this safe. That needs a check against a real database with the new configuration, since this change assumes it does.
